profile.headline: Software Engineer II
profile.summary:
With several years of experience as a passionate software developer, I've immersed myself in the dynamic world of technology, constantly seeking new challenges and opportunities for growth. My journey in software development has been marked by a relentless pursuit of excellence, fueled by a deep understanding of cutting-edge tools and methodologies.

Throughout my career, I've demonstrated a keen ability to leverage my technical expertise in C#, .NET, TSQL, and other modern technologies to deliver innovative solutions that drive business success. From spearheading full-stack web development projects to collaborating with cross-functional teams, I've thrived in environments that demand creativity, collaboration, and agility.

Beyond my professional endeavors, I'm deeply invested in staying at the forefront of industry trends and innovations. I actively engage with the .NET developer community, reading blogs and participating in discussions to expand my knowledge and stay updated with the latest advancements.

Driven by a passion for innovation and a belief in the transformative power of technology, I'm committed to leveraging my skills and experience to make a positive impact. Whether it's crafting user-centric software solutions or exploring new frontiers in AI and ML, I'm dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible and shaping the future of technology.

Let's connect and explore how we can collaborate to drive meaningful change in the world of technology.

positions.title: Information Technology Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Design and deliver cloud-native commerce, product, pricing, search, and quoting capabilities using C#, .NET, Angular, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure.
Architect event-driven workflows with Azure Functions and Azure Service Bus, including message routing, subscriber filtering, dead-letter recovery, and infrastructure managed through Terraform.
Lead technical investigations and proof-of-concept efforts involving Azure AI Search, Databricks, high-volume product data processing, and real-time product updates.
Improve production reliability through Application Insights, KQL dashboards, distributed tracing, correlation IDs, structured logging, and root-cause analysis across interconnected services.
Partner with product owners, architects, QA engineers, business stakeholders, and other development teams to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver business-critical solutions.
Provide technical direction on complex initiatives while supporting code quality, automated testing, peer reviews, and continuous improvement across the engineering team.

positions.title: Information Technology Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack enterprise applications and APIs using C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, SQL Server, and Azure.
Built APIs and workflows supporting customer selection, quote transfers, order drafts, reorder functionality, user impersonation, and storefront-aware business policies.
Developed product-search indexing processes using Azure Functions, Azure AI Search, blob-triggered processing, and scheduled initialization workflows.
Created an API that combined quote and order-draft information to return a deduplicated list of users who created customer records, supported by automated testing.
Built monitoring and troubleshooting tools for pricing integrations, including customer-level error reporting, correlation tracking, time-based filtering, and drill-down access to logs.
Investigated and resolved production issues across APIs, asynchronous messaging, databases, frontend applications, and third-party integrations.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Led full-stack development efforts, crafting internal content management systems critical for streamlining reporting processes and ensuring compliance with rigorous environmental regulations mandated by governing bodies.

positions.title: Technical Services Analyst
positions.description: Responsible for maintaining and repairing highly automated equipment to support Rockwell Automation and third-party vendors' production, conducting electrical and mechanical troubleshooting to identify and fix issues, and following layout plans or manuals to dismantle, adjust, and assemble equipment.

positions.title: Electronics Repair Technician
positions.description: Contract role for Rockwell Automation with being held responsible for installing, repairing, and maintaining a wide variety of electronic devices. Responsibilities include replacing broken equipment, keeping records, and testing equipment.

positions.title: Surface Mount/ Electrical Engineering Technician
positions.description: Set up, operate and troubleshoot SMT equipment. Properly assembled methane detectors according to ISO standards and fine tune devices to stability. Record data numbers to ensure optimal output of devices.

projects.title: Roadsy
projects.description: Road trip web application that helps users design a customized itinerary from starting to end destinations.

projects.title: Standard Repair Generator Bot
projects.description: Create a interactive bot that questions technician on repair being completed. Keeps records of technician name and identification and gives repair advice on input repair types being completed.

organizations.name: Upsilon Pi Epsilon
organizations.description: Upsilon Pi Epsilon (ΥΠΕ): International Honor Society for the Computing and Information Disciplines, is the first honor society dedicated to the discipline of the computing and information disciplines. Informally known as UPE, Upsilon Pi Epsilon was founded on January 10, 1967 at Texas A&M University and has chartered over 270 chapters at college campuses across the world. With the rise of importance of information technology to many fields, other honorary societies have added computer science to their traditional scope.

organizations.name: Computer Science Society
organizations.description: The Computer Science Society is for students at DePaul who are interested in computing, computer science, or just technology in general. This club is a resource that provides an opportunity for students at DePaul University to collaborate on computer science-related projects, expand their education outside the classroom, and to join a network of hardworking people both in school and in the field.
